subject: general
question: According to the Economic Survey 2021-22, what is the rank of India (Globally) in average annual net gain in forest area?
solution:
The correct answer is **'3rd'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• India ranked **third** globally in** an average annual net gain in forest area** between 2010 to 2020. 
 
• **According to the Economic Survey 2021-22**, India has increased its forest area significantly over the past decade, **adding an average of 2,66,000 hectares (ha) of additional forest area, every year during the period.**
 
• In other words, it has added approximately** 0.38% of the 2010 forest area every year between 2010 to 2020.** 
 
• **According to the India State of Forest Report 2021 (ISFR)**, in 2021, the total forest and tree cover in India is 80.9 million hectares, which is 24.62% of the geographical area of the country. It was 24.56% of the total geographical area as per the 2019 report.
